description: Downstream-application compatibility request. This file specifies what the downstream inference program can consume; it is not one of the generated context/user-study cases.

request_identity.natural_language_request: Provide image frames or a frame/video manifest that the ChokePoint YOLO visitor/person monitoring pipeline can consume.

source_requirements.notes: The downstream program expects image/video/frame inputs. Semantic detections or event labels are not accepted as preprocessing outputs for this app request.

utility_contract.task_description: Run the downstream ChokePoint/YOLO person-presence program over image frames and emit person counts/boxes.

accepted_output_caps.utility_notes: Compatible with infer_chokepoint.py because the downstream YOLO model reads image paths/frame directories and performs person detection itself. Redaction/cropping may be encoded as image/x-raw with redacted/minimized properties if detector utility is validated.
Compatible when the manifest gives a video_path or frame_dir that infer_chokepoint.py can iterate into frames.

explicitly_rejected_output_caps.reason: The attached ChokePoint downstream program performs YOLO inference over images/frames; a detection record is the downstream output, not its input.
An event label is not a frame/image input for infer_chokepoint.py.
Activity labels are not a valid ChokePoint visitor-monitoring input.
Audio is not used by the ChokePoint visual visitor-monitoring pipeline.

downstream_program.name: infer_chokepoint.py
downstream_program.model_role: The downstream program runs YOLO/person detection itself.

compatibility_notes: The preprocessor may crop, blur, or sample only if the final payload remains an image/video/frame stream consumable by the ChokePoint inference code and benchmarked utility remains adequate.

compatibility_constraints.accepted_schema_match: candidate output caps must match at least one accepted_output_caps entry
compatibility_constraints.required_capability_match: candidate utility_capabilities must include requested_capability or a declared equivalent
adapter_rules: Adapters may repackage data into the manifest/sample schema required by the downstream program only when the underlying payload type remains compatible.
A privacy-minimized semantic label is not utility-compatible unless the downstream program explicitly accepts that semantic label as input.

residual_disclosure_constraints.comparison_rule: candidate residual disclosure vector must be <= max_allowed for every attribute, except attributes listed in allowed_high_attributes

no_compromise_conditions: Return no_compromise if no candidate pipeline both matches an accepted output cap and satisfies CI/residual-disclosure constraints.
Return insufficient_utility_evidence if the output cap/schema is accepted but no benchmark, calibration, or app-provided validation exists.
Do not select a semantic/privacy-minimized output solely because it is acceptable under CI if the downstream inference program cannot consume it.
